chunk_findings.detail: The added `$schema` URL is for Kilo (`https://app.kilo.ai/config.json`), but `opencode.json` is the OpenCode configuration format used by the existing `mcp` block. In any editor or JSON validator that honors `$schema`, this forces validation against the wrong vendor schema; the valid OpenCode `mcp`/`type: "local"` shape can be rejected or given wrong completions. Before the change there was no `$schema`, so OpenCode/editor used its default schema; the new line is a regression.

chunk_findings.detail: The diff adds `"$schema": "https://app.kilo.ai/config.json"` to `opencode.json`, whose existing `mcp.ddflow` block uses OpenCode’s `type: "local"` MCP server shape. In any editor or JSON validator that honors `$schema`, this now validates the OpenCode configuration against Kilo’s schema instead of OpenCode’s; if the Kilo schema does not define the same `mcp`/`type: "local"` shape, the previously valid config is reported invalid or gets wrong completions. The triage probe only shows commit/diff metadata (`git diff` / `git show --stat`), not that the Kilo schema is compatible with this OpenCode config, so the defect still holds.
